blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Automatic cardiac motion tracking from cine cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging is essential for quantifying myocardial motion abnormalities associated with cardiovascular disease. Existing methods fall into two groups: those that represent motion without anatomical correspondence across subjects and therefore limit inter-subject motion assessment; and those that represent motion with globally corresponding points, which typically require a time-consuming and error-prone semi-automatic step to fit a cardiac atlas to the subject space. To address these limitations, this study proposes CardioDrift, a fully automatic, atlas-based probabilistic framework that represents subject-specific cardiac motion on a 3D atlas mesh with globally corresponding points. The Coherent Point Drift (CPD) formulation is generalised to jointly register the atlas surfaces of multiple cardiac regions to the anatomically corresponding contours extracted from cine CMR segmentation maps throughout the cardiac cycle. Slice-shift correction is embedded in the same probabilistic model, estimating slice-wise translations that suppress the misalignment artefact limiting atlas-fitting accuracy. Evaluation on 1301 randomly selected UK Biobank subjects and the M&M dataset, CardioDrift attains Dice similarity coefficients (DSCs) of $92.23\pm8.70\%$, $82.11\pm7.56\%$, and $88.69\pm4.13\%$ for the left ventricle (LV), myocardium (Myo), and right ventricle (RV), exceeding the strongest baseline on every distance and overlap metric of both datasets.
blocks.zh: 从焚化的心脏磁共振成像(CMR)中自动跟踪心脏运动对量化心血管疾病引起的心肌运动异常至关重要。 现有方法分为两组:一是代表运动而不进行跨主体的解剖对应,从而限制主体间运动评估的方法;二是代表运动与全球对应点的方法,通常需要耗时和容易出错的半自动步骤,将心脏图集与主体空间相匹配. 为解决这些局限性,本研究提出了心动碎片(CardioDrift),这是一个完全自动的、基于地图集的概率框架,它代表了3D图集网格上具有全球相应点的针对具体主题的心脏运动。 协同点漂流剂(CPD)的配体被概括为将多个心脏区域的图集表面联合登记到整个心脏周期从焚烧式CMR分解图中提取的解剖对应的轮廓上. 切换修正嵌入了相同的概率模型,估计了抑制错配动脉限制地图集精度的切片翻译. 对1301个随机选择的英国生物库主题和M&M数据集的评价,心肌脱落达到Dice相似系数(DSC)92.23\pm8.70\%美元,82.11\pm7.56\%美元和88.69\pm4.13\%美元,分别用于左排气管(LV)、心肌(Myo)和右排气管(RV),超过了两个数据集每个距离和重叠度量的最强基线。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Cardiac motion assessment plays a central role in the early detection of cardiovascular diseases, a leading cause of mortality worldwide [ 1 ] . It is typically performed through visual assessment of cine cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging [ 2 ] , a process that is subjective, poorly reproducible, and time-consuming [ 3 ] , motivating considerable effort to automate tracking and quantify motion abnormalities.
blocks.zh: 心血管运动评估在早期发现心血管疾病方面起核心作用,是全世界死亡的主要原因[1]. 通常通过对焚化心电磁共振成像[2]的目视评估来进行,这一过程是主观的,不易再生产,而且耗时[3],激发了对运动异常进行自动化跟踪和量化的大量努力。

blocks.en: Automated methods face two obstacles. Those operating in the image domain represent motion in a subject-specific coordinate space, establishing no anatomical correspondence across individuals and precluding the population-level comparison that assessing pathological motion depends on. Those using a cardiac atlas mesh achieve such correspondence but require a semi-automatic step to fit the atlas to the subject’s space, a process that is error-prone and time-consuming. Moreover, these methods first extract cardiac motion in image space, where it may include motion fields unrelated to the heart, and only then interpolate the motion fields from the image domain onto the mesh, attenuating them in the process.
blocks.zh: 自动化方法面临两个障碍。 在图像领域运作的人代表着特定主题坐标空间中的运动,没有建立个人之间的解剖通信,排除了评估病理运动所依赖的人口级比较. 使用心电图网的人实现了这种对应,但需要半自动步骤,使图集与对象的空间相接,这一过程容易出错并耗费时间。 此外,这些方法首先在图像空间中提取出心动,其中可能包括与心脏无关的运动场,而后才从图像域将运动场插入网格上,使这些运动场在过程中减弱.

blocks.en: This work addresses these obstacles with CardioDrift, a non-learning-based point set registration framework formulated using the Coherent Point Drift (CPD) approach [ 4 ] that automatically fits a cardiac atlas mesh into the subject’s cardiac space and propagates it over the cardiac cycle, using only contour points from cine short-axis (SAX) segmentation maps. A rigid stage first aligns the atlas at the end-diastolic (ED) frame while estimating per-slice translations to correct slice misalignment. A non-rigid stage then deforms the aligned atlas to the slice-shift-corrected contours at each subsequent frame through a shared deformation field. While previous methods lack global correspondence in the derived motion, rely on semi-automatic atlas fitting, capture irrelevant motion through image-domain motion extraction, and attenuate motion through interpolation, CardioDrift automatically fits a cardiac atlas to the subject space accurately and propagates it precisely throughout the cardiac cycle. The main contributions are:
blocks.zh: 这项工作用心电图(CardioDrift)解决了这些障碍,而心电图(CardioDrift)是使用相通点漂流法(CPD)制定的一种非以学习为基础的定点登记框架,它自动将心电图网块接入受试者的心电图空间并在整个心电循环中传播,只使用从焚化短轴(SAX)分取图的等深点。 一个僵硬的阶段首先对端-截面(ED)框架的地图集进行校正,同时估计每片切片的翻译,以纠正切片错配. 一个非刚性相,然后通过一个共享的变形场将对齐的图集变形为后相框上切片-相向修正的轮廓. 虽然以往的方法在衍生运动中缺乏全局对应,依靠半自动地图集接合,通过图像域运动取出来捕捉不相干的运动,并用插入来减弱运动,但心动脱落自动地将心动图集精确地与主题空间相匹配并在整个心脏周期中准确传播. 主要贡献是:

blocks.en: II Background
blocks.zh: 二. 背景情况

blocks.en: Most state-of-the-art methods formulate tracking as image registration, estimating dense pixel- or voxel-wise motion fields from cine CMR. Classical approaches build on free-form deformation [ 5 , 6 ] or the Demons algorithm and its diffeomorphic reformulation [ 7 , 8 ] , while deep-learning methods regress the field in a single forward pass [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] . Bayesian formulations register long-axis sequences [ 12 ] or jointly segment and register SAX slices [ 13 ] . They may capture motions unrelated to the heart because they rely on intensity-based image registration metrics. CardioMorphNet addresses this by guiding motion estimation towards the regions identified by a segmentation branch [ 14 ] . These methods operate in a subject-specific image space and establish no anatomical correspondence across individuals [ 15 , 16 ] , limiting inter-subject motion assessment.
blocks.zh: 大多数最先进的方法都将跟踪作为图像注册,从cine CMR中估算出密集的像素-或阴道运动场. 古典方法建立在自由形式变形[5,6]或"恶魔"算法及其二相变形再造[7,8]的基础上,而深层学习方法则以单向后传[9,10,11]来倒置场. 贝叶斯配方会登记长轴序列[12]或联合分出并登记SAX切片[13]. 它们可能捕捉出与心脏无关的运动,因为它们依赖于基于强度的图像登记指标。 CardioMorphNet通过指导对一个分块分支所确定的区域进行运动估计来解决这个问题。 这些方法在针对主题的图像空间中运作,没有建立个人之间的解剖通信[15,16],限制了主体间运动评估.

blocks.en: Recent studies have formulated cardiac motion tracking in the mesh/point-set domain to enable both intra-subject and inter-subject motion assessment. For instance, Zakeri et al. proposed a deep motion model that predicts the cardiac point set at each time frame and identifies outlier points resulting from excessive deviations from the model prediction [ 17 ] . Although this approach enables intra-subject assessment through outlier detection, its output point sets lack inter-subject correspondence, limiting abnormality assessment to the intra-subject setting. To enable inter-subject correspondence, DeepMesh fits an atlas mesh whose points correspond anatomically across individuals to the subject’s cardiac space and warps it across the cycle using motion fields estimated from multi-view CMR [ 18 ] . This method represents cardiac motion with globally corresponding points under several constraints: the fitting is semi-automatic and requires manual landmark selection; the motion fields are estimated in image space and interpolated onto the mesh in physical coordinates, attenuating extracted motion; and the intensity-based similarity term admits motions unrelated to the heart. Automating atlas fitting is complicated by the heart’s variable position and orientation in physical space [ 19 ] and by slice misalignment [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 最近的研究在网格/定点域建立了心动跟踪系统,以便能够对主体内和主体间运动进行评估。 例如,Zakeri等人提出了深运动模型,预测每个时间段设定的心跳点,并找出因模型预测偏差过大而导致的出站点[17]. 虽然这种方法能够通过外部检测进行主体内部评估,但其产出点却缺乏主体之间的对应,将异常性评估限制在主体内部环境中。 为了实现主体间通信,DeepMesh符合一个图集网格,其各点在解剖学上与主体的心脏空间相对应,并使用从多视角CMR估计的运动场在整个周期中将其扭曲 [18] 。 这种方法代表心脏运动,在几个限制下具有全球对应点:相接是半自动的,需要人工地进行地标选择;运动场在图像空间中进行估计并插入物理坐标的网格上,能减弱被提取出的运动;以强度为基础的类似词允许与心脏无关的运动. 由于心脏在物理空间的可变位置和取向[19]和切片错配[20],自动地图装配变得复杂.

blocks.en: Point-set registration could enable atlas-based motion tracking without manual atlas fitting or image-to-mesh interpolation by operating directly in physical coordinates. Here, contours extracted from cine CMR segmentation maps serve as the fixed point sets, while the corresponding atlas surfaces are the moving point sets. Estimating transformations over the cardiac cycle that fit the atlas surfaces with the subject’s contours represents cardiac motion on the atlas mesh. Non-learning-based methods derive transformations by estimating point-wise correspondences through iterative optimisation or probabilistic modelling [ 21 ] . Among these, CPD performs strongly [ 4 ] , formulating registration as probability density estimation, where moving points parameterise a Gaussian mixture model (GMM) centroids and correspondences are expressed probabilistically and jointly refined with the transformation. Learning-based methods instead predict transformations from latent point-wise features, but generalise poorly beyond their training distribution and degrade under outliers, noise, and sparsity [ 22 ] . These limitations are particularly relevant to CMR-derived contours, which are sparse through-plane, affected by slice misalignment, and prone to segmentation errors. CPD therefore offers a reliable alternative, but its standard formulation neither enforces correspondence between each atlas surface and its anatomical counterpart nor corrects slice misalignment, which limits fitting accuracy.
blocks.zh: 点集登记可以通过直接在物理坐标上操作,使基于地图集的运动跟踪无需手工安装地图集或图像到图像插图。 在这里,从Cine CMR分解图中提取的轮廓作为固定点集,而相应的地图集表面则是移动点集. 对图集表面与主体轮廓相匹配的心脏周期的变换进行估计,代表图集网状的心动. 以非学习为基础的方法通过迭代优化或概率建模来估计出取出点的对应值来得到转变[21]. 其中,CPD表现强 [4],将登记作为概率密度估计,其中移动点参数化出高斯混合模型(GMM)的中间体和对应物以概率表示,并结合转化而共同完善. 以学习为基础的方法则从潜在的点入点特征预测变化,但一般化程度远远超出其训练分布,在外延、噪音和痉挛下降解[22]。 这些限制与遗留集束弹药衍生的轮廓特别相干,这些轮廓通过平面很少,受到片状错配的影响,而且容易发生分化错误。 因此,国家方案文件提供了一个可靠的替代办法,但其标准表述既不强制规定每个地图集表面与解剖对应部分之间的对应关系,也不纠正片段错配,这限制了适当的准确性。

IV Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 四. 实验和结果

blocks.en: IV-A Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: IV-A 实验设置

blocks.en: The framework was evaluated on two datasets. The first comprises cine CMR SAX volumes from a random sample of 1,301 UK Biobank subjects [ 24 ] , segmented into the LV, Myo, and RV regions at every frame of the cardiac cycle with the automated tool of Bai et al. [ 25 ] . The second is the M&M dataset [ 26 ] , which includes 134 subjects; it was acquired at several clinical centres with scanners from four vendors and includes both healthy and pathological anatomy. Expert-annotated masks are provided for M&M only at the ED and end-systolic (ES) time points. The bi-ventricular atlas of [ 27 ] served as the template, with the Endo, Epi, and RV surfaces decimated to 359, 459, and 402 points, respectively.
blocks.zh: 对框架进行了两个数据集的评价。 第一组由1,301个联合王国生物库主题随机抽样的Cine CMR SAX卷组成,用Bai等人的自动工具在心脏周期的每个框架段分入LV、Myo和RV区域。 [25]. 第二种是M&M数据集[26],包括134个学科;它是在几个临床中心购买的,由四个销售商提供扫描仪,包括健康和病理解剖学。 只在ED和端轴(ES)时间点为并购提供专家附加说明的口罩。 以[27]的双文体地图集为模板,远藤,伊庇和房车表面分别被破坏到359分,459分和402分.

blocks.en: The rigid stage is compared against two classical methods, iterative closest point (ICP) and rigid CPD, and two learning-based methods, PCRNet [ 28 ] and PointNetLK [ 29 ] . The non-rigid stage is compared against non-rigid CPD, CPD-Net [ 30 ] , a learning-based extension of CPD, and DeepMesh [ 18 ] , which estimates motion fields from the cine images and interpolates them onto the mesh vertices. All non-rigid methods deform the atlas fitted by CardioDrift’s rigid stage and receive contour points pre-translated by its slice-shift corrections, so the comparison isolates the deformation model; for DeepMesh, this replaces the semi-automatic initialisation of the original formulation. Ablations of the slice-shift correction and the shape-aware modelling are also reported. Both regularisation coefficients were selected by sweeps on the two datasets, given in full in the supplementary material. We adopt λ = 5 × 10 3 \lambda=5\times 10^{3} , which maximises UK Biobank accuracy at a mean per-slice shift of 2.6 2.6 mm, within the range reported by Tarroni et al. [ 20 ] , and β = 3.16 \beta=3.16 , which balances accuracy against the mean Laplacian of the registered mesh; both are used unchanged for the two datasets.
blocks.zh: 将僵硬的阶段与两种古典方法进行比较,即迭接最近点(ICP)和刚性国家方案文件,以及两种以学习为基础的方法,即PCRNet[28]和PointNetLK[29]。 将非硬化的阶段与非硬化的国家方案文件、基于学习的国家方案文件扩展版PD-Net[30]和DeepMesh[18]进行比较,后者估计了从焚化图像中运动的场并把它们插入网状顶点。 所有非刚性方法都使由心形Drift的刚性相接而成的地图集变形,并通过它的切相变换来得到先译出等分点,因此比较隔离了变形模型;对于DeepMesh来说,这取代了原配方的半自动初始化. 还报告了切片-切换校正和形状-认识建模的缺失。 两个正则系数都是通过在两个数据集上进行扫描来选择的,在补充材料中全部给出. 我们采用 = 5 × 10 3\lambda = 5\times 10\ 3}在Tarroni等人[20]所报告范围内,以2.6毫米的每片平均转速将英国生物库的精度最大化;β = 3.16\beta=3.16,在精确度与注册网目的平均拉普拉西安值之间保持平衡;两个数据集均使用不变。

blocks.en: Performance is quantified by the mean surface distance (MSD) and the 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95), both in millimetres, computed between the fitted atlas surfaces and the subject contour points, and by the Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) between the reference masks and those obtained by rasterising the fitted surfaces onto the SAX volume grid. The rigid stage is evaluated at the ED frame, at which the atlas is fitted; the non-rigid stage is evaluated across all frames on UK Biobank and, following annotation availability, at ED and ES only on M&M.
blocks.zh: 性能用平均地表距离(MSD)和95-百分位的Husdorff相距(HD95)来量化,两者均以毫米计,在装配的地图册地表和地表等同点之间计算,并以参考口罩与将装配的地表光栅接入SAX电网获得的地表相似系数(DSC)来计算。 硬相片在ED框架进行评价,并配有地图集;非硬相片在联合王国生物银行的所有框架进行评价,并在得到说明后,只在并购和销售方面在ED和ES进行评价。

blocks.en: IV-B Rigid Registration Performance
blocks.zh: IV-B 严格登记性能

blocks.en: The UK Biobank rigid block of Table I reports the quantitative comparison on that cohort. Against the baselines, CardioDrift achieves the lowest HD95 and MSD for all three regions and the highest DSC for the LV, Myo, and RV. CPD outperforms ICP on every metric but still yields substantially larger distances and lower overlap than CardioDrift, while ICP obtains the largest geometric errors. PCRNet improves on PointNetLK in HD95 and MSD and attains a competitive RV DSC of 75.04%, yet both lag behind throughout, reflecting the difficulty of deriving correspondences in a single forward pass from sparse and heterogeneous contours.
blocks.zh: 表一中的联合王国生物银行僵硬块报告了该组群的数量比较。 根据基线,心电图实现了所有三个区域最低的HD95和MSD,而LV、Myo和RV则达到了最高的DSC。 国家方案文件的绩效高于比较方案每一度,但仍比心肌脱裂率大得多,重叠率更低,而比较方案得到的几何误差最大。 PCRNet在HD95和MSD的PointNetLK上有所改进,实现了75.04%的竞争性RV DSC,然而两者都始终落后,反映了从稀有和多相通的轮廓中以单向后转而得出通信的困难。

blocks.en: The same comparison on M&M is reported in Table I . The ordering of the methods is preserved, with CPD again the strongest baseline and ICP and PointNetLK the weakest, but absolute performance is lower for every method, while the margin of CardioDrift over the strongest baseline holds up, at 28.2 28.2 percentage points of LV DSC and 28.3 28.3 points of Myo DSC against 22.6 22.6 and 28.5 28.5 on UK Biobank, and remains substantial on all nine metrics. The learning-based methods degrade most in relative terms: PointNetLK loses 15.3 15.3 percentage points of RV DSC ( 51.48 % 51.48\% to 36.16 % 36.16\% ) and PCRNet 11.0 11.0 points ( 75.04 % 75.04\% to 64.06 % 64.06\% ). This is consistent with the domain-shift sensitivity of single-pass learned registration.

blocks.en: The UK Biobank non-rigid block of Table I reports atlas propagation over the cardiac cycle. CardioDrift achieves the lowest HD95 and MSD for all regions and the highest DSC throughout. The largest gain is in the Myo DSC, which rises from 64.91 ± 9.98 % 64.91\pm 9.98\% (CPD), 60.41 ± 12.57 % 60.41\pm 12.57\% (CPD-Net), and 60.90 ± 15.79 % 60.90\pm 15.79\% (DeepMesh) to 82.11 ± 7.56 % 82.11\pm 7.56\% . blocks.en: The M&M non-rigid block reports the corresponding results, which are confined to ED and ES. CardioDrift is best on every metric, and the Myo again shows the widest margin: 76.81 ± 12.43 % 76.81\pm 12.43\% against 55.80 ± 16.18 % 55.80\pm 16.18\% for CPD, 48.35 ± 17.29 % 48.35\pm 17.29\% for CPD-Net, and 38.04 ± 14.87 % 38.04\pm 14.87\% for DeepMesh, gaps of 21.0 21.0 , 28.5 28.5 , and 38.8 38.8 percentage points that exceed those on UK Biobank. The two learned methods are the most affected by the change of cohort: CPD-Net falls behind plain CPD for every metric except LV DSC, while on UK Biobank the two remain close, and DeepMesh loses 22.9 22.9 percentage points of Myo DSC and 18.6 18.6 of RV DSC between the datasets, against 5.3 5.3 and 4.2 4.2 for CardioDrift.

blocks.en: Fig. 2 (b) shows a representative UK Biobank tracking result. The atlases propagated by CardioDrift stay closer to the contour points throughout the cycle and delineate the ED-to-ES transition more faithfully than the three baselines, most visibly in the Myo at ES (frames 20 and 30), indicating that it captures the large inward displacement of the myocardial wall while keeping the mesh smooth and anatomically plausible.

blocks.en: IV-D Slice-Shift Correction Performance

blocks.en: The two CardioDrift rows of the UK Biobank rigid block in Table I isolate the effect of slice-shift correction. Enabling it improves every LV and Myo metric, most notably Myo DSC ( 55.76 ± 12.68 % 55.76\pm 12.68\% to 70.25 ± 12.27 % 70.25\pm 12.27\% ), while the three RV metrics are marginally better without it. These population-level differences are modest, but the subject-level effect matters: without correction the fitted atlas is visibly offset in a subset of cases (Fig. 3 (a)–(d)), an error that would propagate into the non-rigid stage.

blocks.en: The corresponding M&M rows show a weaker but consistent effect. Correction improves seven of the nine metrics, again with Myo DSC the most responsive ( 44.45 ± 18.56 % 44.45\pm 18.56\% to 60.21 ± 19.10 % 60.21\pm 19.10\% ); the exceptions are RV HD95 and RV MSD, marginally lower without correction, matching the pattern on UK Biobank. The reduced benefit follows from the acquisition protocols: UK Biobank stacks are acquired under a standardised sequential breath-hold protocol in which misalignment is systematic and well described by one in-plane translation per slice, whereas the multi-protocol M&M stacks leave more residual misalignment outside the model.

blocks.en: V Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 讨论和结论

blocks.en: This study introduced CardioDrift, a fully automatic, atlas-based framework for representing subject-specific cardiac motion on a 3D atlas mesh with globally corresponding points, requiring only cine CMR SAX segmentation maps. Its core design generalises CPD by jointly registering the Endo, Epi, and RV atlas surfaces to their anatomically corresponding contours under a shared transformation, establishing correspondence within each region rather than across an undifferentiated point set. Moreover, it incorporates slice-shift correction during atlas fitting to the subject’s cardiac space, reducing inter-slice misalignment and improving atlas-fitting accuracy. Compared with state-of-the-art methods, CardioDrift represents subject-specific cardiac motion on an atlas with globally corresponding points, without requiring manual atlas alignment in the subject’s cardiac space. Moreover, it avoids capturing irrelevant motion and the need for image-to-mesh interpolation, reducing attenuation of the derived motion because it operates entirely in the mesh/point-set domain and is based on cardiac contours.
blocks.zh: 这项研究引入了CardioDrift,这是一个完全自动的以地图集为基础的框架,用于在具有全球相应分数的3D地图集中代表特定主题的心动,只需要Cine CMR SAX分解图. 其核心设计概括了国家方案文件,将远藤、Epi和RV地图集的表面共同登记在了共同转变下的解剖对应轮廓上,在各区域内部而不是在无差别的一组点内建立对应关系。 此外,它包括了在适合主题心脏空间的地图集中进行切换校正,减少剪切间错配,并改进地图集的准确性。 相较于最先进的方法,心动脉动(CardioDrift)在具有全球相应分数的地图集上代表了针对主题的心动,而不需要在主题的心动空间中进行手动的地图集对接. 此外,它避免捕捉不相干运动和需要图像到图像插值,减少衍生运动的减弱,因为它完全运行于网/点设置域并基于心脏轮廓.

blocks.en: CardioDrift outperformed all baselines on every metric of both datasets. In the rigid stage, the probabilistic formulation expresses correspondence as a soft assignment refined iteratively, suiting the sparse, noisy, and heterogeneous cardiac contour sets, precisely the conditions under which single-pass learning-based methods perform poorly. Embedding slice-shift correction in the same EM procedure reduces the inter-slice misalignment that would otherwise bias the alignment. These translations are estimated only at ED and held fixed thereafter, since the full cine sequence for a slice is acquired within a single breath-hold and the misalignment arises from diaphragm position varying between breath-holds, that is, between slices [ 24 , 31 ] ; it is an artefact of acquisition rather than cardiac phase. Unlike DeepMesh [ 18 ] , the closest prior work, which requires semi-automatic initialisation and interpolates image-space motion fields onto the mesh, CardioDrift automatically fits the atlas to the subject’s cardiac space using only the contour points, removing both manual intervention and the associated motion attenuation.
blocks.zh: 心电图的性能超过了两个数据集中每一公分量上的所有基线。 在僵硬的阶段,概率式的表达方式是一种反复完善的柔性任务,它适应了稀少、吵闹和多端的心形轮廓,正是单行道学习方法表现不佳的条件。 在同一EM程序中嵌入切片相变的校正会减少错位间错位,否则会偏向对齐. 这些译出仅在ED上估算,并在之后被固定下来,因为切片的全切入序列是在一气位内得到的,而错位则出自于气位相差的隔膜位置,即切片之间[24,31];这是取入的动脉,而不是心跳相. 与DeepMesh [18] 不同的是,前作中最接近的工作需要半自动地初始化,并将图像-空间运动场插入网格上,心动Drift自动地将图集与被主体的心脏空间相匹配,只使用等深点,同时去除手动干涉和相关的运动衰减.

blocks.en: In the non-rigid stage, the largest gain was in Myo DSC, the most difficult region to track owing to its thin structure and large inward displacement at ES. The shape-aware mechanism is decisive: treating the three regions as distinct within a shared deformation field resolves correspondence anatomically rather than geometrically. The comparison with DeepMesh is the most direct of the three baselines, since it likewise propagates a corresponding atlas mesh but differs in how deformation is obtained: its motion fields are estimated from the image domain and interpolated onto the mesh space, and its DSC is 11.0 11.0 percentage points below CardioDrift for the LV and 12.2 12.2 for the RV, indicating that image-to-mesh motion interpolation degrades tracking.
blocks.zh: 在非硬化阶段,最大的收益是在Myo DSC, 由于其结构薄弱和在ES中大量向内迁移,该地区最难追踪。 形状感知机制具有决定性作用:将三个区域作为共同变形场内的独特区域处理,从解剖角度而不是从几何角度解决对应问题。 与DeepMesh的比较是三个基线中最直接的,因为它同样传播了相应的地图集网格,但在如何得到变形方面却有所不同:其运动场从图像域来估计并插入网格空间,其DSC的LV比心电图差11.0-11.0个百分点,而RV比12.2比12.2,表明图像到网格运动插图降解了跟踪.

blocks.en: The M&M evaluation tests these mechanisms outside the standardised UK Biobank acquisition. Likewise UK Biobank, CardioDrift obtains the best rigid and non-rigid registration performance among the baselines, whereas the learned methods lose most, CPD-Net falling below CPD and DeepMesh, which additionally depends on vendor-dependent image intensities, showing the largest drop of any non-rigid method. Because correspondence is re-estimated per subject by EM rather than predicted from learned features, CardioDrift has no training distribution to depart from, and its behaviour is governed by the geometry of the contours presented to it; the regularisation coefficients, selected on UK Biobank and retained unchanged for M&M, support the same point. The one mechanism whose benefit diminishes is slice-shift correction, since a single in-plane translation per slice describes systematic breath-hold misalignment more completely than the heterogeneous residual misalignment of a multi-protocol cohort.
blocks.zh: 监测和评价评价在联合王国生物银行标准化收购之外测试这些机制。 同样,英国Biobank公司CardioDrift公司在基线中获得了最好的硬性和非硬性登记业绩,而学到的方法损失最多,PDD-Net公司低于CPD和DeepMesh公司,这还依赖于依赖供应商的图像强度,显示非硬性方法的下降幅度最大。 由于函授是由EM重新对每个科目进行估计,而不是根据所学的特征进行预测,CardioDrift没有可以脱离的训练分布,其行为受到向其呈现的轮廓几何的制约;在UK Biobank上选择的,并且为M&M保留不变的正则系数支持同一点. 利益减少的一种机制是零星的分机调整,因为每片一个单机内翻译更完整地描述了系统性的气压错位,而不是多管子组群的多管子组群的多管子残位错位。

blocks.en: Several limitations motivate future work. The first is computational cost: ( 15 ) must be solved independently at each frame; replacing the iterative EM with a learned model is a natural remedy, though a hybrid coupling a network with a few EM iterations is more promising than a single forward pass, given the sparsity and heterogeneity of cardiac contours. Second, the method depends on the input segmentation, whose errors propagate directly into the contour points; jointly refining the contours from cine CMR image features, or modelling segmentation uncertainty end-to-end, would reduce this sensitivity. The third is the scope of the M&M evaluation, where reference masks exist only at ED and ES, so temporal consistency over the intermediate frames rests on UK Biobank only. Finally, the formulation includes no term controlling the temporal smoothness of the output mesh sequences. Addressing these would extend the accuracy and anatomical interpretability demonstrated here into a computationally efficient framework for large-scale inter-subject cardiac motion assessment.
blocks.zh: 有几个限制促使今后的工作。 首先是计算成本:(15 )必须在每个框架独立解决;用学习到的模型来取代迭代EM是一种自然的补救方法,尽管由于心脏轮廓的痉挛和异质性,将一个网络与几个EM迭代相接的混合耦合比单个前行通道更有希望. 第二,该方法取决于输入分解,其错误会被直接传播到等位点;联合从cine CMR图像特性来提炼等位,或者建模分解不确定性从端到端会降低这种敏感性. 第三是M&M评价的范围,其中参考口罩只存在于ED和ES,因此中间框架上的时间一致性仅取自UK Biobank. 最后,该配体没有包括控制输出网状序列的时间平滑度的术语. 解决这些问题将使此处所显示的准确性和解剖性扩大,成为大规模主体间心动评估的计算效率框架。
